summary: This chunk is a software/cybersecurity adjacency to the broader AI infrastructure theme. The strongest Serenity priority is Varonis because AI deployment plausibly increases the need to classify, govern, and secure sensitive enterprise data before model access is expanded. Tenable ranks close behind because cloud, identity, and AI workload expansion can enlarge the attack surface, but exposure management may face more platform-consolidation pressure. Samsara has a differentiated physical-operations data-layer angle but is less directly tied to the AI infrastructure bottlenecks evidenced in Layer 2. SentinelOne has AI-security relevance, but the signal is more crowded, more marketing-sensitive, and less underfollowed than the others. All four remain hypotheses because the supplied evidence does not include current company filings, earnings-call excerpts, ARR metrics, retention data, or customer proof.
